Access of disabled to education
*1. PROF. (SHRIMATI) BHARATI
RAY : Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India has more than five
crore disabled people;
(b) whether over 98 per cent of them
have little or no access to education and
scholarships are given only to deserving
disabled students with limited means; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to provide a helping hand for
the disabled persons in view of their great
success in every field?
Operation at Tandur Plant of CCI
*2. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY :
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO :
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that operation at
Tandur Plant of Cement Corporation of
India (CCI) has resumed;
1
(b) the installed capacity of the plant;
(c) whether his Ministry has released
the amount for working capital and
modernisation, as assured by him; and
(d) if not, when his Ministry is going to
released the funds?
Criteria for recognising hospitals etc.
*3. SHRI SURYABHAN PATIL
VAHADANE :
SHRI ANIL SHARMA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of criteria adopted in
recognising the private hospitals/diagnostic
centres under CGHS at Delhi, Faridabad,
Gurgaon etc., vide OM F.No. Rec-24/2001/
JD(M)/CGHS/DELHI/CGHS(P), dated
the 7th September, 2001; and
(b) the reasons for excluding and de-
recognising Hospitals like Batra Hospital,
New Delhi, Escorts Heart Institute, New
Delhi, Escorts Hospital and Research
Centre, Faridabad, Holy Family Hospital
and Sundar Lal Jain Hospital, Ashok Vihar,
Delhi?

2

Protective measures against natural
calamities
*4. SHRI NAGENDRA NATH
OJHA:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had written to all State Governments
pointing out which of their territorial areas
were prone to natural calamities such as
earthquake, cyclone and floods and
suggesting protective measures which they
should take to minimise the likely damage
in case any such disaster struck;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the States who responded to the
suggestions made and the measures taken/
being taken by these States in this regard;
and
(d) further steps being taken by
Government to pursue the matter with the
remaining States?
Institutions for disinvestment
*5. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL : Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether names of certain institutions
have been forwarded to Government for
disinvestment;
(b) if so, the decision taken in respect
of the institutions for the purpose of
disinvestment till September, 2001; and
(c) the details of the institutions, out of
them, which are not making any production,
due to sickness and Government are forced
to contribute for their maintenance
annually?
Prevention of Anthrax
*6. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of Anthrax affected
persons in Karnataka;
(b) the number of persons died due to
Anthrax in the State;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
prevent/eradicate Anthrax in the State; and
(d) the financial and medical facilities
provided, so far?
Use of infrastructure facilities by
private F.M. Radio Companies in
Metros
*7. SHRI C.P. THIRUNAVUKKA-
RASU : Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow private F.M. Radio Companies to
use the infrastructure facilities in the
metros;
(b) if so, whether any feasibility study
has been conducted in this regard;
(c) if so, the recommendations made by
the study; and
(d) whether any Memorandum of
Understanding has been signed for
providing the facilities, so far?

3

Strategy to tackle the problems of
slums and its dwellers
*8. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT AND
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have prepared and finalised a slum policy;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
two-pronged strategy would be adopted
to tackle the problems of slums and their
dwellers;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the total amount, so far, agreed to be
provided in implementing the scheme; and
(e) the States where this scheme will be
introduced?

Financial crisis in the North-Eastern
States
1. DR. MANMOHAN  SINGH:
SHRI W. ANGOU SINGH:
Will the Minister of  DEVELOPMENT
OF NORTH EASTERN REGION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the States of  North-Eastern
Region are now facing financial crisis and
are not able to pay the employees’ salaries
even;
(b) if so, the different measures taken by
Government to meet the present financial
crisis in the North-Eastern  States; and
(c) the existing financial position of each
State of North-Eastern Region?
Integrated development plan
formulated for NER
2. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of integrated development
plan formulated for North Eastern Region
during the Ninth Plan;
(b) the amount allocated, utilized and
achievements made, so far, year wise;
(c) the details of investment proposed
for development of tourism Infrastructure
during the Ninth Plan in the NER; and
(d) the details of programmes being
executed for manpower development in the
tourism sector of the region, including
training of tourist guides?
Assistance to North-Eastern Region
for electrification of villages
3. SHRI ANANTRAY DEV-
SHANKER DAVE: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government through their
agency, Rural Electrification Corporation
(REC) have provided loan assistance to
North-Eastern Region/States for
electrification of villages by installing energy
meters;
(b) whether loan assistance provided
under ’’Special Loan Portfolio-Capital SL
(Meters) Scheme’’ has been misutilised and
not disbursed to the SSI manufacturers of
energy meters; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against the officers responsible for
misutilisation and misappropriation of
Government funds?

2
Plan for development of roads in
North Eastern Region
4. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of  DEVELOPMENT
OF NORTH EASTERN REGION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of action taken by
Government to develop the Roads in the
North-Eastern Region in connection with
comprehensive economic development;
(b) whether the Dhodar Ali, a 17th
century road, connects many towns of
Assam as well as connects Chansglang and
Tirap Districts of Arunachal Pradesh and
Mon and Mokakchung Districts of
Nagaland through link roads; and
(c) whether Government would consider
to propose to convert it into a National
Highway as an infrastructure for
development of vast areas of Assam,
Arunachal Pradesh and Nagaland?
Decision to speed-up disinvestment of
PSUs
5. SHRI C.M. IBRAHIM: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether, as indicated at the meeting
of the Council on Trade and Industry held
in New Delhi on September 7, 2001,
Government have decided to hasten
privatization of specified PSU;
(b) if so, the details of these PSUs; and
(c) the steps since taken for privatization
thereof?
News-item "Separate law for
disinvestment’’
6. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the newsitem captioned
’’Separate Law for disinvestment needed:
Expert,’’ which appeared in the Hindustan
Times, dated 10th September, 2001;
(b) if so, Government’s reaction thereto
and whether Government share the
perception of the experts with regard to
the lackadaisical approach of Government
to disinvestment process so far; and
(c) if answer to part (b) above be in the
affirmative, the steps proposed to be taken
to ensure a satisfactory fulfilment of the
disinvestment programme?
Financial bids for privatisation of
PSUs
7. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have invited
financial bids for privatising a number of
Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs); and
(b) if so, the names of the PSUs and the
procedure adopted to invite financial bids
for these PSUs?
Disinvestment of PSUs
8. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
disinvestment of several Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs) recently; and
(b) if so, the names of the PSUs
approved for disinvestment and by when
the process of disinvestment will be
completed?
